description: มุน 2026-07-29 (service-hub follow-up, ฟีม's 2 calls): (A) typo card 7 ซินเเส→ซินแส — a DELIBERATE divergence from Figma by ฟีม's ruling (I flagged the Figma spelling, ฟีม confirmed ซินแส), recorded in services.ts. (B) extract home's local BellButton/AvatarButton (3 pages had 3 different bell/avatar impls) into shared v2-shell components used by home/calendar/service. Bug-class the anchor owns: EXTRACTING A SHARED COMPONENT SILENTLY CHANGES A CONSUMER — a page's bell/avatar loses its behaviour (nav <a> vs in-page <button>) or its skin, OR home (shipped, ฟีม uses it) shifts pixels; a refactor that compiles can still move a click or a pixel. run-shared-topbar.ts proves at COMPONENT level (renderToStaticMarkup): TopBarBell is polymorphic (href→<Link>/<a>, onClick→<button>) — the SINGLE point where the bell's destination changes — and skin-per-variant (solid=cyan/glyph-A/unread-slot vs mate=gradient/lime/glyph-B), each reproducing its page's exact pixels; TopBarAvatar sapphire=interactive-button-letter vs mate=decorative-aria-hidden-span. In-browser: home bell stays a <button> (in-page panel, unchanged), calendar bell is <a>→/v2/calendar/notifications (unchanged), service bell is <a>→notifications + service avatar <button>→opens the logout confirm (ฟีม's new default). HOME PIXEL-IDENTITY (shipped-screen constraint): before(clean a2d7e79) vs after pixelmatch @393 — home HEADER region (y<260) 0-diff (the 738/3.3M lower-page px are live fortune/mascot, y≥1506), calendar day 0/6.1M diff. All prior anchors green (header-structure/calendar-day/flow/notifications/service-hub). Teeth: mut-ignore-href (bell always <button> → calendar+service stop navigating), mut-ignore-variant (always solid → mate skin wrong). Both demonstrated live (CAUGHT). OPEN (surfaced to ฟีม, NOT decided): the unified look — 3 pages still 2 skins; now one component so unify = one-line variant change (บอง: 'อย่าเพิ่งตัดสินเอง'). gate_layer=visual/shared-component-extraction+behaviour-polymorphism+shipped-pixel-identity. ⚠️ enforced_by REMOVED 2026-08-06 (มุน, on บอง's ruling): the anchor named here is not run by CI and not run by anything else, so the field was advertising a guard that does not exist — the same shape ตู๋ caught in #189/#191. The rule is connect it or withdraw the claim, never leave the claim standing. The anchor file itself is kept and its assertions were retargeted to the post-ทาง ข design; wiring it into CI belongs to the harness-tidy batch, not to this PR. WAS: harness/run-shared-topbar.ts#mut-ignore-href
